# Michelle Sadsad Luyenga — Marketing Web Developer
> Marketing web developer building fast, measurable websites on Astro and Next.js, and connecting them to e-commerce, CMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation, advertising, and workflow tools. Open to client projects and full-time roles.

## Platforms
- Astro (flagship): new marketing sites and migrations where speed and SEO matter most
- Next.js (when needed): headless storefronts, personalization, and app-like experiences
- Platform guide: https://www.michellevision.com/platforms

## Core Services & Packages
Engagements are scoped asynchronously based on technical complexity, data volume, and integration requirements:
- Legacy Migration & Integration: migrations to Astro or Next.js, ETL data pipelines, URL redirects, CRM/ERP data syncing, GA4 and tag manager setup, secure hosting.
- Turnkey Design, Build & Scale: UI/UX design, site build on Astro or Next.js, CDP/CRM/marketing automation integration, analytics event planning, ad conversion tracking, launch QA and handoff.
- Headless Commerce & Growth: headless storefronts, product feeds for Google and Meta, abandoned-cart and post-purchase automation, server-side purchase tracking, order and inventory workflow automation.
- Single integrations and add-on modules, including headless WordPress with an Astro front end.

## Integration Coverage
- E-commerce: Shopify Storefront API, Stripe
- CMS: Sanity, headless WordPress
- CDP: Segment
- CRM: HubSpot
- Analytics & BI: GA4, Looker Studio
- Marketing automation: HubSpot Marketing, Mailchimp
- Advertising: Google Ads, Meta Conversions API, server-side Google Tag Manager
- Marketing & SEO: structured data, sitemaps and RSS, UTM governance
- Workflow integration: Make, Zapier
- ERPs and internal company dashboards
